title: The Inverted Gorge

features.name: the upside-down cliff
features.desc-on-touch: A rock face that hangs from the sky—or was it always meant to hang? The paths here run both up and down them at once. Walking is forgetting which direction you chose.

features.name: the meeting water
features.desc-on-touch: Two streams converge here, but they flow in opposite verticals—one rises, one falls. Where they touch, the water forgets which way the earth pulls.

features.name: the neutral stone
features.desc-on-touch: A single boulder resting perfectly level between the two gravities. Neither up nor down has convinced it to choose. You could sit here and feel balanced in both directions.

features.name: the spiral descent-ascent
features.desc-on-touch: A path that winds around itself without changing height. You follow it and arrive where you started, but in a different direction. Forgetting, in motion.

features.name: the uncertain vegetation
features.desc-on-touch: Plants here grow both toward and away from the light at once, roots reaching skyward, branches drinking from the earth. The corruption has taught them that direction is a choice.

inscription: descent and ascent occupy the same column here; the only difference is memory
